Title: KMRD Hyder Seasonal Housing Facility
Description: KMRD Hyder Seasonal Housing Facility (Rental Services) This is a non-personal services contract to provide a housing facility for the Forest Service Ketchikan-Misty Fjords Ranger District (KMRD), Tongass National Forest (TNF), Alaska. The Government shall not exercise any supervision or control over the contract service providers performing the services herein. Such contract service providers shall be accountable solely to the contractor who, in turn, is responsible to the Government. Background and Purpose: KMRD owns and operates the Fish Creek Wildlife Observation Site in Hyder, Alaska. Hyder is a remote Southeast Alaska community with approximately 50–100 residents, located about 75 air miles from Ketchikan, Alaska, and 2 miles from Stewart, British Columbia. KMRD staffs the Fish Creek Wildlife Observation Site annually from July through September. During this operational season, KMRD employees must reside in Hyder; however, KMRD currently does not have adequate facilities to house these employees and therefore requires the rental of suitable seasonal housing. Requirement Description: The contractor shall furnish all labor, supervision, management, tools, materials, equipment, facilities, transportation, and other items and non-personal services necessary to provide a housing facility in Hyder, Alaska, for use by employees of the Forest Service Ketchikan–Misty Fjords Ranger District. The contractor shall provide services in accordance with (IAW) this Work Statement (WS), and all applicable federal, state and local laws and regulations. Place of Performance: The housing facility shall be located in Hyder, AK 99923. Period of Performance: The period of performance shall be for 1 Base Period of 12-months and 4 Option Periods of 12-months each.

Title: SRD Vault Pumping Services
Awardee: RAINFOREST SERVICES, LLC Sitka AK 99835 USA
Description: SRD Vault Pumping Services This is a non-personal services contract for vault pumping services for the Forest Service, Sitka Ranger District (SRD), Tongass National Forest (TNF), Southeast Alaska. The Government shall not exercise any supervision or control over the contract service providers performing the services herein. Such contract service providers shall be accountable solely to the contractor who, in turn, is responsible to the Government. Purpose: The purpose of this contract is to ensure that vaults and septic equipment located in the Sitka Ranger District remain safe, sanitary, and fully operational throughout the open season; comply with all applicable Environmental Protection Agency (EPA), National Environmental Policy Act (NEPA), and Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) requirements; and support the continuous, reliable, and sanitary operation of all units. Description of Services: The contractor shall furnish all labor, supervision, management, tools, materials, equipment, facilities, transportation, and all other items and non?personal services necessary to provide vault pumping services at multiple sites within the Sitka Ranger District. Services include, but are not limited to, pumping, sewage disposal, cleaning, and backfilling to ensure all units remain safe, sanitary, and operational. All services shall be performed in accordance with (IAW) this Performance Work Statement (PWS) and all applicable local, state, and federal standards, laws, and regulations. Place of Performance: The work shall be performed in Sitka, Southeast Alaska. Period of Performance: The period of performance (POP) shall be for 1 Base Period of 12-months and 2 Option Periods of 12-months each.
